How to Apply
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 11-09-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Goa University Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Junior Research Fellow position at Goa University is 11th September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master's degree in Physics with at least 55% marks and have qualified in NET/GATE or an equivalent national-level examination.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Junior Research Fellow position is 35 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per government norms.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Junior Research Fellow role?
faq.answer: The salary for the Junior Research Fellow is Rs. 37000/- plus HRA @10% for the first two years, and Rs. 42000/- plus HRA @10% for the third year.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the Goa University Junior Research Fellow recruitment?
faq.answer: Interested candidates need to send their complete application with all required documents via email before the last date.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC/SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Junior Research Fellow position will be based on an interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is GU/DTT/RDRM/19010/2026.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent or contractual job?
faq.answer: This is a contractual job opportunity at Goa University.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article, under the 'Official Notification PDF' link.
